name: Caleria
storyline: The player ventures into a fractured medieval world filled with dangerous creatures, hidden secrets, and forgotten places. Through exploration, quests, and encounters across villages, forests, roads, and ruined cities, players shape their own journey while uncovering the mysteries surrounding the kingdom and its ominous red moon.
summary:
Caleria is a 2D top-down open-world medieval RPG focused on exploration, discovery, and player-driven adventure. Set within the mysterious Grimward Kingdom, players can explore diverse regions, interact with unique characters, complete quests, uncover hidden secrets, and face dangerous creatures.

Key features include open-world exploration, multiple character roles, quest and trading systems, survival mechanics, combat, and a world filled with hidden discoveries.
